response.rationale: The mass is a well-defined, homogeneous fat-signal lesion on ultrasound and MRI, with complete fat suppression and a retromammary/pectoral location, most consistent with a lipoma. Hamartoma would contain non-fat fibroglandular tissue and not suppress completely; fibroadenoma would not be fat-suppressed or hyperechoic.

rejected.why: Hamartoma is a mixed fat/fibroglandular breast lesion, not a homogeneous fat-signal mass deep to the pectoralis; complete fat suppression and homogeneous hyperechogenicity favor lipoma.
Fibroadenoma is a solid fibroepithelial tumor, typically hypoechoic and not fat-suppressed; the huge fat-signal mass with no internal vascularity is incompatible.
